descriptionChirho: Proper noun designating Jahaz (also spelled Yahats, Yahtsah), a city in Moab whose exact location is uncertain. Site of the decisive battle where Israel under Moses defeated Sihon king of the Amorites (Num 21:23; Deut 2:32; Judg 11:20). Assigned as a Levitical city in the territory of Reuben (Josh 13:18; 21:36; 1 Chr 6:78). Referenced in prophetic oracles against Moab: the cry of Moab reaching to Jahaz (Isa 15:4) and the voice heard from Jahaz (Jer 48:21, 34). Also mentioned in the Mesha Inscription (lines 19-20). All auto-split clusters represent the same toponym with varying prepositions, directional he, and minor orthographic differences.
